scope: Average-day visits around 2024, using 2022-24 UN Tourism observations or earlier baseline
origin_method: UNMEASURED: country population^0.7 * geographic decay * diaspora affinity
origin_definition: country of usual residence proxy, NOT country of birth
uncertainty: 3 and 10 nights are duration scenarios only, not statistical confidence bounds.
warning: Visitor ORIGINS are heuristic, not tourism-bilateral observations; missing destination observations are NOT zero visitors. Do not add directly to birth-origin migrant stock without noting incompatible origin definitions.
